ideas.title: The Minnesota Child Care Center Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud against the Minnesota child care center that received $1.5 million from 'Feeding Our Future'.
questions: How did the child care center allegedly commit fraud?
What was the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a large amount of taxpayer dollars and potential abuse of a program meant to help vulnerable populations.
